candidate.title: SupplyTGN: A Reproducible Leakage-Safe Benchmark for Temporal Software Supply-Chain Risk
documentedMethodologicalProperties: Released per-instance predictions and a reproducible benchmark builder.

blockingConditions: The disclosed benchmark population is PyPI/OSV component-cutoff instances, not npm package versions.
The disclosed outcomes are vulnerability-oriented within the PyPI/OSV benchmark, not a documented npm malicious-publication or maintainer-compromise coverage contract.
No npm-specific frozen population, row-level package-version extract, or matched npm observation horizon is supplied.
permittedUse: Methodological reference for pre-registering cutoff-safe features, leakage audits, horizons, and per-instance release artifacts after an npm-specific control contract is available.
prohibitedInterpretations: Do not transfer reported PyPI/OSV performance results to npm.
Do not treat PyPI non-events as npm benign controls.
Do not use this source to fit or evaluate npm ranking, calibration, PR-AUC, Recall@K, logistic-regression, blast-radius, or attack-return models.
